next_action.description: Sweep the detail-transfer split radius (currently hard-coded at 10 px in detail_transfer.py / transfer_clip.py) to see whether a coarser high-pass drops the invented veins Fabio saw at detail 70-100% while keeping the reconstruction. key_decisions: SIGMA IS NOT THE CHANGE KNOB - Fabio rejected that framing twice and he is right. Sigma controls REGENERATION, so change and quality ride on it together: dropping 0.85 to 0.50 buys identity by giving back the reconstruction that made 0.85 worth having. The control has to act AFTER the pass. Do not re-propose sigma as the answer.

sigma 0.85 is the TARGET LOOK, not a rejected arm. Its three defects are identity, the deleted zipper, and a full regrade of the lighting - all of them structural or low-frequency, which is exactly why a frequency split can hold them.

The temporal upscaler is CLOSED NEGATIVE. Rejected by eye on the frames it invents ('just a blob') AND the frames it was handed ('undercooked'). Not a tuning problem - do not re-open it with a different sigma or frame count. The hybrid arm was deliberately NOT run: interleaving blobs with sharp real frames makes the defect more visible, not less.

The detail-transfer op is a DAMAGE LIMITER, not a hallucination control. The model hallucinates just as much; the dial only decides how much survives, by keeping high frequencies and discarding low ones. It therefore cannot filter invented TEXTURE - which is the veins, and which Fabio found unprompted on first viewing.

Every instrument on this card has now failed at least once when read alone: radial-FFT top/mid (no-sampler control outscores the visibly-best runs), laplacian variance (scores the visibly-softer temporal frame SHARPER than the real source), drift and flicker (blind to the swim). Always pair an instrument with a control run, and never rank across pipeline variants.

NOTE: VHS frame_load_cap counts RETURNED frames after select_every_nth, so frames=25 + stride 2 gives 25 frames spanning source 0..48.
